observations: Single photo shows a disassembled front headlight/headlamp assembly lying on a cloth-covered surface.
Watermark on the photo reads 'HONDA AND ACURA'.
No visible brand or part-number markings on the lens or housing.
No wiring, bulbs, or connector shown to judge electrical completeness.
Background shows other loose parts, suggesting a scrapyard/parts-breaker setting.
Seller's text claims a generic stock of body, engine and suspension parts for Honda, Acura and Toyota vehicles.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy.
claims.evidence: photo 0 watermark reads 'HONDA AND ACURA', not Toyota, so the part shown does not match the Toyota claim.

claims.claim: No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: Only one angle shown; clips/brackets on the rear and mounting points are not visible.

claims.claim: Stocks body, engine and suspension parts for all Honda, Acura and Toyota models.
claims.evidence: Only one headlight photo provided; no engine or suspension parts shown.

risks.risk: Mismatch between claimed vehicle make (Toyota) and watermark (Honda/Acura) suggests the photo may be reused or mislabeled.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part with a visible OEM part number or vehicle badge matching the claimed make.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified/unverified compatibility, worst case

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, fog, or scratches on the lens not visible from this single angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens front, back, and mounting tabs from multiple angles.

risks.risk: Electrical function (bulbs, wiring, adjuster motor) unknown.
risks.proof: A video of the headlight powered on showing low/high beam and turn signal working.

risks.risk: Fitment to a specific car model/year not confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo of the part number sticker or confirmation of exact make/model/year it fits.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/unconfirmed fit, worst case

proof_requests: Clear photo of any part number or brand marking stamped on the headlight housing.
Photo of the vehicle make/model this specific headlight was pulled from.
Video showing the headlight powered on (beams and indicator working).
Additional photos of the rear housing, connector, and all mounting clips.
response.reason: The seller claims an 'Original Toyota part' but the only photo carries a watermark reading 'HONDA AND ACURA', directly contradicting the specific brand claim and suggesting a reused or mismatched image.
